title: Error variants carry String instead of structured fields (AttestorError, SignerError)
description:
rust.md: "Error variants must carry structured fields, not `String` messages. `Err(format!(\"expected {x}, got {y}\"))` loses the values."

persona-attestors/src/lib.rs:88-97:
    Unavailable(String)
    ChallengeFailed(String)
    Io(#[from] std::io::Error)

persona-core/src/signer.rs:14-37:
    KeyGen(String)
    Sign(String)
    Jwt(#[from] jsonwebtoken::errors::Error)
    NotImplemented(String)
plus two `From` impls that stringify structured errors on the way in:
`From<ring::error::Unspecified> -> Sign(e.to_string())` and `From<ring::error::KeyRejected> -> KeyGen(e.to_string())`.

What is lost, concretely:
- ssh.rs:92 `AttestorError::Unavailable(format!("cannot connect to SSH agent: {e}"))` throws away an `io::Error` whose `ErrorKind` distinguishes "agent not running" (ConnectionRefused, expected, skip the source) from "permission denied" (a real misconfiguration to report). Callers get one opaque string. Same shape at tailscale.rs:42 and :58, gpg.rs:103 and :115, oidc.rs:179.
- `SignerError::NotImplemented(String)` is matched in the test at signer.rs:164 but the payload is never read; the only two possible values are compile-time constants, so this should be a fieldless variant or an enum of the unimplemented operations.
- persona-grpc/src/service.rs:181-185 maps every `SignerError` to `Status::internal(e.to_string())`. With structured variants it could map `NotImplemented` to `Status::unimplemented` and keep `internal` for genuine failures.

Fix: give `Unavailable` and `ChallengeFailed` a `{ source_name: String, #[source] cause: ... }` shape (or dedicated variants per cause), keep the ring/jsonwebtoken errors as `#[source]` rather than `to_string()`, and make `NotImplemented` fieldless.

Also check the thiserror rule while editing: do not both interpolate a source error and mark it `#[source]`. `Io(#[from] std::io::Error)` with `#[error("IO error: {0}")]` currently duplicates the io message when the chain is rendered — pick one.
close_reason: Duplicate of persona-5s4b.15 (same defect, filed by a second review agent from a different angle). Merged during review triage; reopen if the angle in this issue is not covered there.
